items.title: API Authentication & Authorization
items.description: OAuth 2.0 flows, JWT structure and validation, API keys, mTLS, OIDC, token introspection, and Spring Security integration.

items.title: Application Protocols Reference
items.description: SSH, SMTP, FTP, MQTT, AMQP, LDAP, NTP and other essential application-layer protocols — how they work and when to use them.

items.title: DNS Resolution
items.description: How DNS works end-to-end — resolution chain, record types, caching, TTL, DNSSEC, and common DNS patterns.

items.title: Docker Networking
items.description: Complete guide to Docker networking — bridge, host, overlay, and none drivers, container DNS resolution, port publishing, creating custom networks, and connecting containers across Compose services.

items.title: Essential Linux for DevOps & Cookbook
items.description: An exhaustive, 1000-line deep dive into Linux for DevOps, featuring advanced commands (awk, sed, find), network tracing, system tuning, and bash scripting.

items.title: HTTP, HTTPS & Application Layer
items.description: A complete guide to HTTP — from beginner fundamentals to senior-level protocol internals. Covers methods, status codes, headers, caching, TLS, CORS, and HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3 evolution.

items.title: IP Addressing & Routing
items.description: IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnetting, CIDR notation, NAT, routing protocols, and how packets find their way across the internet.

items.title: Network Performance & Optimization
items.description: Latency, bandwidth, throughput, connection pooling, keep-alive, HTTP/2 multiplexing, QUIC, compression, and practical tuning techniques.

items.title: Network Security
items.description: TLS deep dive, common network attacks, DDoS mitigation, zero trust networking, certificate management, and security best practices.

items.title: Network Troubleshooting & Diagnostic Tools
items.description: Practical guide to tcpdump, Wireshark, netstat, ss, nmap, curl, openssl, dig, traceroute and how to diagnose every layer of the network stack.

items.title: Networking & IPC
items.description: Network stack internals, socket programming, TCP deep dive, IPC mechanisms, and high-performance networking with Java NIO and Netty patterns.

items.title: Networking Interview Questions — Master List
items.description: Comprehensive compilation of the most common networking interview questions across all topics, organized by category and difficulty.

items.title: Networking Knowledge Base
items.description: A comprehensive reference covering OSI/TCP-IP models, TCP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, CDN, security, sockets, REST, gRPC, WebSockets, QUIC, and more — with interview questions.

items.title: OSI & TCP/IP Models
items.description: The OSI 7-layer model and TCP/IP 4-layer model — each layer's role, protocols, and how data encapsulation works end-to-end.

items.title: Proxies, NAT & Firewalls
items.description: Forward and reverse proxies, NAT traversal, stateful firewalls, iptables, VPNs, and how traffic flows through network boundaries.

items.title: QUIC & Modern Transport Protocols
items.description: QUIC protocol internals, HTTP/3, connection migration, 0-RTT, multiplexing without HOL blocking, and comparison with TCP+TLS.

items.title: Services & Networking
items.description: Kubernetes networking guide — Service types (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName), Ingress, DNS, NetworkPolicy, and how traffic flows from the internet to a Pod.

items.title: Socket Programming & I/O Models
items.description: Blocking vs non-blocking I/O, Java NIO, epoll, the C10K problem, Netty, and how event-driven servers handle massive concurrency.

items.title: TCP, UDP & Transport Layer
items.description: TCP's three-way handshake, flow control, congestion control, connection termination, and UDP — when to use each and how they work.

items.title: TCS Interview Experience 2024 | TCS Ninja, NQT & CodeVita
items.description: A comprehensive guide covering real technical interview questions and answers from a TCS Ninja/NQT interview for a fresh engineering graduate. Covers Core Java, OOPs, Data Structures, HTTP, OS, and Networking.

items.title: VPC Fundamentals for Developers
items.description: VPC essentials for DVA-C02. Subnets, route tables, security groups vs NACLs, NAT Gateway, VPC Endpoints (Gateway vs Interface), bastion hosts, and common developer scenarios like Lambda-in-VPC and private RDS access.
